research_question: Can rigidly synchronized eyewear RGB plus IMU establish observable metric camera height and sparse ground geometry on fresh real parents without external ToF or evaluator truth?

route_identity.name: VI-Task Geometry
route_identity.future_concept_if_g0_passes: active computation, feature, keyframe and parallax allocation under a separately frozen successor

hardware_contract.one_time_wear_height: A1 comparator and plausibility receipt only; never evaluator truth or per-frame A2/A3 scale input

external_basis.work: M5Stack AtomS3R official hardware and IMU documentation
external_basis.bounded_relevance: confirms onboard BMI270 and official IMU access; does not establish synchronization, calibration or VIO quality

external_basis.work: VINS-Mono: A Robust and Versatile Monocular Visual-Inertial State Estimator
external_basis.bounded_relevance: supports monocular camera plus low-cost IMU as a metric 6DoF research substrate; does not validate this hardware or cohort

external_basis.bounded_relevance: supports an explicit excitation/observability control; it is a recent preprint and not BlindAssist evidence
supports phone-camera depth-from-motion teacher experiments without mandatory ToF; ARCore cannot ingest AtomS3R MJPEG as its tracking camera and prior local D45 remained not evaluable

fresh_source_contract.parent_definition: one site-by-surface-by-rigid-mount session; repeated episodes in the same mount are not new parents

capture_admission.device_clock_domain: single esp32_boot_monotonic sequence for camera and IMU
capture_admission.camera_loss_rule: every device frame_sequence slot from first through last is materialized; unavailable JPEG is LOST_BEFORE_WRITER or INVALID_JPEG and remains in denominators

comparators.A0: DepthART-only ground/height estimate; no truth, fixed height, IMU or ToF
comparators.A1: DepthART plus one predeclared fixed wear-height scalar; no per-frame truth or IMU scale
comparators.A2: frozen monocular VIO sparse metric geometry plus gravity-constrained ground plane; no DepthART or truth
comparators.A3: A2 sparse metric anchors robustly align the frozen DepthART dense prior; no truth access
comparators.implementation_rule: exact VIO source commit, configuration, initialization, excitation gate, feature policy, ground fitter and DepthART identity must be hash-bound in activation before first fresh capture

truth_contract.camera_height: independent per-frame RGB optical-center height with uncertainty <=0.01 m
truth_contract.sparse_geometry: independent metric checkpoints not derived from any comparator
truth_contract.ground_labels: evaluator-only GROUND, NON_GROUND or UNRESOLVED labels for every candidate support identity
truth_contract.clearance: independent obstacle clearance probes retained as diagnostic only in G0

observability_policy.rule: initialization, excitation, feature/parallax, ground support and residual gates must all pass before A2/A3 emit metric geometry; otherwise UNKNOWN

primary: parent-macro and worst-parent observable-episode height coverage
unsafe metric-valid rate on degeneracy controls

winner_rule.eligible_primary_arm: A2 or A3 independently passes every absolute gate; A0/A1 never win G0

required_before_first_fresh_capture: exact AtomS3R-M12 device identity and firmware hash with ToF disabled
OV3660 intrinsics and BMI270-to-camera extrinsics plus calibration hashes
independent height/sparse/clearance reference identities and uncertainty receipts
exact A0-A3 source/configuration hashes and frozen observability gates
capture/truth writer hashes and empty exclusive artifact root

stopping_rule.pass: Only establishes bounded fresh physical metric-frame observability and permits a separately frozen task-geometry successor; it does not authorize active allocation or Android alerts.
stopping_rule.fail_or_not_evaluable: Close the VI metric task-geometry route without outcome-driven rescue and move to a height-free gravity-normalized angular/TTC representation.

claim_ceiling: pre-outcome RGB-IMU metric-frame protocol and capture mechanics only; no real VIO, metric height, clearance, training, device, product, safety or paper result
